newsitem.title: HUNGARY: JO REGGELT FROM REUTERS HUNGARY - AUGUST 18.
newsitem.headline: JO REGGELT FROM REUTERS HUNGARY - AUGUST 18.

text.p: Jo reggelt, good morning from Reuters Hungary.

FOREX - 0823 GMT - Dlr/mark recovers after early losses below 1.81 but almost a pfennig below Friday close in Europe. Chart support in mid-1.80s held. Eye on asset markets after Dow slide on Friday. FTSE down over 1.0 pct in early trade, IBIS DAX pares losses. Jitters about Buba meeting Thursday. Rexrodt sees no danger on inflation. Japan July trade surplus up 69.7 pct, below forecast.

STOCKS - UK's FTSE 100 at day's best above 4,800 but still off 1.2 pct after futures trim losses. Sept futures down 37 pts. Gilts slightly higher, U.S. bonds firm in overnight trade. Wall St sell-off, profit-taking still loom over UK index. First leisure up 4.5 pct on report of possible Bass bid.
